title: Finding the Right Alternatives | J.P. Morgan
description: SUBSCRIBE: http://jpm.com/x/i/NFPWfK0  Apply to J.P. asr.full_text: I'm an analyst in Global Investment Management. Global Real Assets is a real assets alternatives business that operates in real estate infrastructure in maritime and we help our clients invest in the alternatives real assets base. As an analyst your responsibility is really the day toto-day work on these assets. Whether it's property valuations, its working on the budgets, its working on client reporting, business plans, strategy reviews... so my day-to-day role is to support the asset managers and the business plan of the properties that we buy. JPMorgan Chase has a culture and it's a work hard culture, it's a respect each other culture. It's a support our clients. It's a do the right thing. It's everything that you hear JV Diamond say.
